title: Card Credential
description: A card credential whose verification scheme is the card verification code (CVC). The `number` field MAY carry an FPAN, a network token, or a wallet-issued token — the credential type is defined by its verification fields, not by the underlying PAN form. CRITICAL: Both parties handling card credentials with raw FPANs MUST be PCI DSS compliant. Transmission MUST use HTTPS/TLS with strong cipher suites.

number.description: Card number. May be an FPAN, network token, or wallet token; the discriminator is the credential type, not the number form.

cvc.description: Card verification code. Optional at the protocol level; merchants can require it via `required_fields` on the funding-source constraint.

constraint.title: Card Credential Constraint
constraint.description: Constraint shape for the `card` credential type.
